description: This file defines the StreamingQueryListener interface and related event classes for Spark Structured Streaming. It includes event classes for query start, progress, idle state, and termination, along with JSON serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: StreamingQueryListener
classes.description: Abstract interface for listening to Spark streaming query events, with methods for query start, progress, idle, and termination.

classes.name: StreamingQueryListener.QueryStartedEvent
classes.description: Event class representing the start of a streaming query, including query IDs, name, timestamp, and job tags.

classes.name: StreamingQueryListener.QueryProgressEvent
classes.description: Event class representing progress updates of a streaming query.

classes.name: StreamingQueryListener.QueryIdleEvent
classes.description: Event class indicating that a streaming query is idle and waiting for data.

classes.name: StreamingQueryListener.QueryTerminatedEvent
classes.description: Event class indicating that a streaming query has terminated, with optional exception details.

methods.name: onQueryStarted
methods.description: Method called when a query starts.

methods.name: onQueryProgress
methods.description: Method called when there is a progress update in a query.

methods.name: onQueryIdle
methods.description: Method called when a query becomes idle.

methods.name: onQueryTerminated
methods.description: Method called when a query terminates.
